title: Woolapalooza at Drumlin Farm
description: Celebrate shearing season with sheep-shearing demos, sheepdog herding, baby lambs, a Sheep-to-Sweater interpretive trail, yarn crafts, and hands-on activities. Food trucks on site from 11 AM. A beloved spring tradition for all ages!

title: Discovery Museum – First Friday Free Night
description: Explore the museum and Discovery Woods for free on the first Friday of the month! Hands-on STEAM activities, water play, outdoor nature trails, and a toddler-safe play area await your family.

title: Smolak Farms Easter Egg Hunt
description: Two Easter Egg Hunts for children ages 1 to 9, plus visits and photo opportunities with farm animals. Enjoy the farm's beautiful spring grounds, cider donuts, and classic family fun.
price: Ticketed event – see website for pricing

title: Boston Children's Museum – Dream It! Build It!
description: This limited-time exhibit offers construction, architecture, and engineering challenges for kids. Build with blocks of every shape and size, create structures with wooden planks, and explore three floors of hands-on fun.

title: Boston Family Days – Free Museum Sundays
description: Boston students (grades K-12 & Pre-K) plus two family members get free admission to the Museum of Science, New England Aquarium, Franklin Park Zoo, and more on the first and second Sunday of every month.
price: Free for eligible Boston students + 2 guests

title: Princess & Superheroes Day at Stone Zoo
description: Dress in your fairytale best and meet favorite princesses and superheroes! Enjoy arts and crafts, dance to a live DJ, meet zookeepers, and explore the animal exhibits. A magical day for little ones.

title: Cherry Blossom Celebration at Arnold Arboretum
description: Celebrate Japanese culture amid blooming cherry trees with taiko drumming by Odaiko New England, traditional Japanese dance, calligraphy, games, and family activities. Bring a blanket and enjoy this free spring tradition.

title: Swan Boats Opening Day
description: The iconic Swan Boats return for the season! Enjoy a 12-15 minute pedal-powered ride around the Public Garden lagoon. A beloved Boston spring tradition since 1877 — no advance tickets needed.

title: Patriots' Day Reenactments & Parade
description: Witness Revolutionary War battle reenactments at Lexington Green and Old North Bridge. Costumed performers, musket demonstrations, fife and drum corps parades, and living history bring the events of 1775 to life.

title: Discovery Museum – Earth Week
description: Explore our connection to the Earth through science, art, and play during April school vacation week. Special Earth-themed activities, outdoor Discovery Woods exploration, and hands-on STEAM challenges for curious kids.

title: Davis Farmland Spring Opening
description: Davis Farmland reopens for the season with over 100 rare and endangered baby animals, a splash park, giant sandbox, hayrides, and a hedge maze. One of the best farms for toddlers and young kids.

title: Blue Hills Reservation – Family StoryWalk & Guided Hikes
description: Enjoy a self-guided StoryWalk with a spring-themed picture book, plus gentle one-mile guided walks and citizen science hikes during April vacation week. Free programming from the DCR amid beautiful trails and views.

title: Gore Place Sheepshearing Festival
description: A 30+ year tradition featuring live shearing demos, herding dogs, 100+ craft and fiber artists, historic reenactors, live music, wagon rides, and hands-on activities. Free shuttle from off-site parking. Rain or shine!
price: General admission – see website for pricing

title: Japan Festival Boston
description: The largest Japanese festival on the East Coast! Two days of authentic Japanese food (ramen, okonomiyaki), stage performances, cosplay fashion show, kids' corner workshops, vendors, and cultural activities on Boston Common.

title: World Flamingo Day at Franklin Park Zoo
description: Wear pink and celebrate these magnificent birds! Special flamingo-themed activities, animal encounters, and educational programs. Explore the Tropical Forest pavilion, meet gorillas and lions, and enjoy the playground.

title: New England Aquarium – Weekend Visit
description: Discover the Giant Ocean Tank, penguin colony, seal presentations, and touch tanks. The IMAX theater features stunning ocean documentaries. A must-visit for families who love marine life.

title: Museum of Science – Weekend Discovery
description: Explore over 700 interactive exhibits, live presentations, the famous Lightning Show, Butterfly Garden, and Planetarium shows. Perfect for curious kids of all ages — plan for a full day of discovery.

title: Run of the Charles Canoe & Kayak Race
description: Boston's premier paddling event with 3-, 6-, and 9-mile courses for canoe, kayak, and stand-up paddleboard. All skill levels welcome — great for families to watch or participate along the scenic Charles River.
price: Free to watch / Registration required to race
